**Possibly, but the evidence cannot establish that it was a eucalyptus harvest.**

About 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss was mapped in 2023. Of that area, 0.4 ha overlapped forest mapped in 2021 as planted eucalyptus; the remaining 0.3 ha was outside mapped forest. The loss data do not identify the cause, so harvest, fire, storm damage or clearing cannot be distinguished from this evidence alone.
